limitations.arguments: Explicit writes not subsequently read in the call-site basic block; calls consume/reset pending writes. Core and VFP allocation are independent (AAPCS-VFP).
limitations.callbacks: Exact symbolic storage-location equality, including literal/data pointers and one-hop registration helpers; unmatched address references remain unresolved, never matched by field offset alone.
limitations.limits: [INFERENCE] Register writes can be temporaries; preserved/forwarded arguments, stack arguments, cross-block results, virtual dispatch and general alias analysis are not proven. Excess declared inputs are notes, not failures. C++ is explicitly unchecked, as in interfaces.py.
limitations.results: Explicit r0/s0 reads before overwrite, branch, return or another call in the continuation block; tail-call results are unknown.
limitations.rewrites: Recorded inline_nop/inline_insn sites restore erased calls. Their callee identity is recorded-source evidence, not independently recoverable from the original image.
